blocks.title: Entropy
blocks.text: Entropy us baat ka paimana hai ke kisi khas darja hararat par system mein energy kitne tareeqon se taqseem ho sakti hai. Jab energy zyada tareeqon se taqseem ho to system zyada mustahkam hai. Entropy ko system ki be-tarteebi (randomness ya disorder) ka paimana bhi samjha ja sakta hai: jitni zyada be-tarteebi, utni zyada system ki entropy.
System zyada be-tarteeb hone par energy ke lihaz se zyada mustahkam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek hi gas ke do namoone ek hi darja hararat par hain, magar ek ko dugne hajm mein phailne diya gaya hai. Kis ki entropy zyada hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Bare hajm wale namoone ki. Us ke molecules aur un ki energy izafi jagah mein kahin zyada tareeqon se tarteeb pa sakte hain, to tareeqon ki tadaad, aur yun entropy, zyada hai; phaili hui halat zyada mustahkam hai.

items: Entropy S energy (aur zarraat) ki taqseem ke tareeqon ki tadaad, ya system ki be-tarteebi, napti hai; zyada tareeqe yani zyada be-tarteebi aur zyada istehkam.
